description: This PHP source file defines the ScreenPermissionService class, which provides methods for managing screen permissions within the OrangeHRM HRM System. It includes functions to retrieve permissions for roles, access specific screens, and interact with DAO classes related to screen permissions.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionService
classes.description: Service class that manages screen permissions, providing methods to retrieve role-based permissions, specific screens, and current context screens.

methods.name: getScreenDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ScreenDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of ScreenPermissionDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getScreenPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves resource permissions for a given module, action URL, and roles. Provides default permissions if no specific permissions are found.

methods.name: getScreen
methods.description: Retrieves the Screen entity for a given module and action URL.

methods.name: getCurrentModuleAndScreen
methods.description: Returns the current module and screen context using the ModuleScreenHelper.

methods.name: getCurrentScreen
methods.description: Gets the current Screen entity based on the current module and screen context.
